title: finance-dashboard
text:
Convex deployed and verified. The live deployment uncommon-butterfly-321 now reports tax:deleteForeignIncome requiring both userId: string and id, confirming the new signature is what's actually running, not just what's in the repo.

Where this leaves you:

The backend is fixed. ctx.db.delete no longer runs without an ownership match, so the vulnerability is closed at the authorization boundary even though Vercel still serves the old frontend.

That mismatch has one consequence worth knowing: the deployed Next.js route still calls the mutation without userId, so deleting a foreign income record on the live site is currently broken and will fail argument validation until you deploy Vercel. This is the expected, safe direction of the two-step (backend strict before frontend updated), and it only affects that one delete action. Everything else is untouched.

To finish, from finance-dashboard/:

Per your CLAUDE.md I won't run that without you saying so explicitly, since it replaces the live site. Note the runbook also warns a plain preview vercel deploy will fail during prerender with Missing publishableKey, because preview has no env vars configured, so preview is not a useful check here.

Say the word and I'll run the production deploy.
